pokedexEntries.ru: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

pokedexEntries.sa: POOCHYENA is an omnivore - it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This POKéMON tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

pokedexEntries.em: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.

pokedexEntries.dpp: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

pokedexEntries.sc: It bares its large fangs and barks vigorously to try to intimidate opponents, but this is actually a manifestation of its cowardly nature.

pokedexEntries.vi: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.
